AgentCompass v0.6.8 adds GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the shipped model data. It builds on v0.6.7.

- **GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol (`gpt-6.2-astra`, `gpt-6.2-sol`).** OpenAI released both on 2026-11-17 in Codex and the API. The catalogue has their rows beside GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol: the vendor list prices (Astra USD 8 input, 0.40 cached input, 40 output per million tokens; Sol 2, 0.10, 10), their Artificial Analysis readings at five efforts (Intelligence Index, time per task, the coding and image sub-benchmarks), the efforts Codex CLI 0.169.1 lists for them (`low` to `ultra`), and bundles for Codex and Pi (Astra at `high` and `xhigh`, Sol at `medium` to `max`). arena.ai does not list them yet, so the scores no public board measures for them (creative writing, design, faithfulness, responsiveness) are converted from the previous release of the same line along the tier fit and marked estimated; they become measured on a data refresh after the boards list them.
- **GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol stay.** OpenAI still offers them and has not rolled 6.2 out to every plan, so they are not marked superseded and all four route. Where a Codex or Pi install does not offer a 6.2 model (a Codex CLI older than 0.169.1, a plan without it), the live model check leaves its bundles out and says so in the warnings. The Sol line now forms its own series for score conversion, so a Sol row without a measurement converts from a Sol sibling instead of an Astra or Terra one.
- **The Artificial Analysis source reads the page again.** The page changed the shape of its embedded model records, and the parser, which looked for a record by its first key, read none. It now reads a record by the key it owns. This affects maintainers running `agentcompass data refresh`; shipped data was not affected.

Not verified on a live account: a launch of the 6.2 models through Codex or Pi, and their fast mode, which is therefore not enabled. Their tier is computed on today's boards while the other rows keep the boards of the last full refresh, so their converted scores are slightly conservative until the next full refresh.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.6.8/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
